content.comment_body: Hello, I need to compare the values of two counters. Does anyone have suggestions on how to do this?

Hello [user_name]! The approach depends on what outcome you're looking for. 1) With [article_no], you can bring each counter value into an analog multiplexer and convert both to analog. An analog comparator can then identify which value is larger or smaller, and you can use this to control a digital output. 2) With [article_no], it's a bit simpler. Just connect the counter values to the Analog Arithmetic block and subtract one from the other. If the result falls within -32768 to +32767, you'll have an analog value to work with or use threshold comparison for triggering. Hope this clarifies things.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Off delay depending on how long the input is on.' Best regards [user_name]
